description: Schedule a clip for future publishing. `publishAt` must be a future UTC ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. "2026-06-01T16:00:00.000Z"). For X (formerly Twitter) each post costs 1 credit. Returns a `scheduleId` you can pass to opus_cancel_scheduled_post.

clipId.description: Curation ID (e.g. "CU67da38"), NOT the full clip id.

mediaType.description: Media type — supported values depend on the platform (typically "video")

publishAt.description: Future publish time in UTC ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-06-01T16:00:00.000Z".

subAccountId.description: Required for Facebook pages, Instagram business accounts, and LinkedIn — from opus_get_social_accounts.subAccountId.

name: opus_schedule_post
